marketMood: Geopolitical-led risk-off: US-Iran weekend airstrikes and Hormuz closure fears weigh on futures, with a pivotal Tuesday of June CPI, five big bank earnings, and Fed Chair Warsh's debut congressional testimony looming.

topStories.headline: US and Iran Trade Weekend Airstrikes; Tehran Claims Strait of Hormuz Closed
topStories.summary: Iran and the US exchanged airstrikes over the weekend; Tehran declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to commercial traffic, though President Trump disputed this on Sunday, saying the key waterway remained open to ships.
topStories.marketImpact: Oil elevated: Brent ~$76/bbl, WTI ~$72; S&P 500 futures ↓ 0.2%; energy stocks XOM, OXY, CVX ↑; gold ↑ safe-haven bid; shipping and LNG at risk

topStories.headline: Meta Posts Best Week Since Early 2024 on AI Cloud Compute Initiative
topStories.summary: Meta Platforms surged ~15% last week — its strongest weekly performance since early 2024 — after announcing a new 'Meta Compute' unit to sell excess AI computing capacity externally, reframing its $125–145B annual capex as a potential revenue source.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↑ 15% WTD; AI cloud narrative extends to non-hyperscalers; watch for follow-through or profit-taking at Monday open

topStories.headline: SK Hynix (SKHY) Begins Regular Nasdaq Trading After Record $26.5B IPO
topStories.summary: SK Hynix's Nasdaq-listed ADRs begin regular trading today under permanent ticker SKHY after debuting Thursday at $149 and closing up 13%, in the largest-ever US listing by a foreign company; the Korean chipmaker controls ~60% of the global HBM market and says its full 2026 output is already sold out.
topStories.marketImpact: SKHY ↑ watch on HBM demand confirmation; NVDA (key HBM customer) ↑ watch; AI memory complex broadly in focus

topStories.headline: ByteDance and Alibaba Shut Down AI Companion Features Ahead of China's July 15 Rules
topStories.summary: New CAC regulations effective July 15 ban platforms from offering emotional AI companion services; ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen are disabling customisable AI persona features, with Tencent's Yuanbao also scaling back.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK (Alibaba) ↓ watch; 0700.HK (Tencent) ↓ watch; China consumer AI monetisation narrative re-rated; minors entirely barred from companion AI

topStories.headline: Nikkei Slips Monday on Risk-Off; Japan AI Component Makers Flag H2 Supply Crunch
topStories.summary: Nikkei 225 opened lower at ~68,177 Monday on geopolitical jitters and chip sector overhang; book-to-bill ratios for high-end MLCCs at Taiyo Yuden, Murata, and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have hit COVID-era highs, signalling a potential AI server component shortage in H2 2026.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei ↓; 6976.T (Taiyo Yuden) ↑ on pricing power; 6981.T (Murata) ↑; AI server build timelines at risk if component shortage materialises

topStories.headline: Triple Catalyst Tuesday: June CPI, Five Bank Earnings, and Warsh's Debut Testimony
topStories.summary: June CPI (forecast: −0.1% MoM, ~3.9% YoY) lands at 8:30am ET Tuesday, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, BofA, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup all report Q2 earnings pre-market, and new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his debut congressional testimony to the House 90 minutes after the inflation data drops.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-path repricing risk both ways; JPM, BAC, GS, WFC, C ↑↓ on earnings; TLT and rate futures highly sensitive; September rate hike probability at ~64%

topStories.headline: Semiconductor Selloff Extends Into New Week; Chip Sector Sheds Over $1 Trillion in 10 Sessions
topStories.summary: The VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) is down ~8% over the past 10 sessions and the broader chip sector has shed over $1 trillion in market value, with Intel, AMD, and Micron under sustained pressure from AI capex sustainability fears and the open-source AI shift.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA showing relative strength vs peers; AMD ↓; INTC ↓; MU ↓; SMH ↓; hyperscaler capex commentary in bank earnings will be the key read-across this week

topStories.headline: China Faces Biggest Data Week of 2026: Trade, GDP, Retail Sales All in Focus
topStories.summary: China releases June trade data Tuesday and Q2 GDP, June retail sales, and industrial output Wednesday — the most comprehensive demand check yet since the World Bank cut its 2026 growth forecast to 4.4% (below Beijing's ~5% target).
topStories.marketImpact: HSI and CSI 300 sensitive to prints; 9988.HK, 0700.HK as China growth proxies; commodity demand outlook and Hang Seng direction in focus

companiesToWatch.name: SK Hynix
companiesToWatch.reason: First regular Nasdaq session after its $26.5B IPO debut — the market's continued vote on AI memory demand and HBM supply scarcity.

companiesToWatch.name: Meta Platforms
companiesToWatch.reason: Carrying a 15% weekly gain after announcing an AI cloud compute business; Monday is the test of whether the narrative holds or profit-taking takes over.

companiesToWatch.name: JPMorgan Chase
companiesToWatch.reason: Earnings pre-market Tuesday; NII guidance and any Bitcoin ETF commentary are the key watchpoints for the rate-sensitive financial sector.

companiesToWatch.name: Nvidia
companiesToWatch.reason: Showing relative outperformance in the chip selloff; SKHY's successful debut and sold-out HBM production reinforces the AI infrastructure demand thesis.

companiesToWatch.name: Citigroup
companiesToWatch.reason: Most globally exposed of the mega-banks to Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption risk; Q2 earnings Tuesday will reveal trade-finance and cross-border exposure.

BOJ's July 30–31 policy meeting widely expected to hold at 1%; central bank may raise growth outlook but trim inflation forecast slightly on softer oil prices. (Nikkei Asia)
